subtitle: 호텔 룸서비스로 저녁 주문하기
desc: 객실에서 룸서비스로 음식과 음료를 주문하고 도착 시간을 확인하는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Hello. I'd like to order room service, please.

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Of course. What's your room number?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Room 412. Could I get a club sandwich and a Caesar salad?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Sure. Would you like anything to drink?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: A bottle of still water and an orange juice, please.
turns.ko: 탄산 없는 생수 한 병이랑 오렌지 주스 주세요.

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Any allergies we should know about?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: No nuts, please. How long will it take?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: About twenty-five minutes. We'll knock and leave the tray if you prefer.
turns.ko: 약 25분이요. 원하시면 노크하고 트레이만 두고 갈게요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Please bring it in. Can I charge it to the room?
turns.ko: 방으로 들어와 주세요. 객실 앞으로 결제해도 될까요?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Yes. I'll add it to your bill. See you shortly.
turns.ko: 네. 계산서에 넣어 드릴게요. 곧 가겠습니다.

tips.en: I'd like to order room service.
Would you like anything to drink?
Can I charge it to the room?
